name: SOLARIS-23
author: swtdr34mz
summary: A microtonal drone and ambient machine: four drones of five free-running saws (each oscillator tuned freely, a light sensor, VOLT for FM), two chaos drones, two morphing VCOs on the pads, LFOs, a joystick, a 5-step sequencer on the MPC tempo, a dual 12 dB filter, distortion and a dual effector of 24 programs.
